changes_from_v001: Changed only the relationship-field segment in both plain and proof from cover-cropped single to fixed fit-single.
Preserved the full 16:9 group frame on a static dark-green canvas so all four people and the shared toast remain visible.
Kept source anchors, frame counts, grade, other crops, and source-only motion unchanged.
situation: Three licensed unedited shots from one evening picnic session, containing tactile food-and-glass detail, one person's wine action, an individual laughter reaction, and a four-person toast.
hypotheses_under_test: A sensory relay becomes meaningful when each scale adds a new role: texture, action owner, embodied reaction, and relationship field.
The same pink wine, hands, food, and evening light can bridge distance changes without generic color matching.
A fixed non-cover relationship release is justified when it preserves people and shared action that a vertical cover crop would delete.
purpose: Test sensory-scale-relay as a general observational friendship edit without music, copy, effects, zoom, retime, or reference-media reuse.

strengths: The sources share people, objects, location, time, light, and social action.
Each planned shot contributes different information rather than a duplicate crop.
The full-width fitted toast preserves four people and supplies a real relationship destination.
limits: The final relationship image is an explicit horizontal memory window inside a vertical canvas.
The material supports friendship atmosphere but not a product claim or brand recovery.
